name: Krystal
summary: UK web hosting company, a certified B Corp running on renewable energy, selling cPanel shared, business and reseller hosting, managed WordPress, configurable VPS and public cloud, with UK-based support by ticket, live chat and phone.
best_for: UK small businesses, freelancers and agencies that want cPanel or managed WordPress hosting with UK-based phone and chat support, one price per billing period without a teaser rate, and a host with B Corp and renewable-energy commitments
skip_if: you want the lowest possible first-year price (budget hosts' introductory terms undercut it), you need your server outside the UK (the VPS configurator offers London only), or you need 24/7 phone support on a small plan (it starts at Sapphire)
honest_knock: Krystal does not win on sticker price. Shown before VAT, Amethyst is £8.40 a month for a UK buyer and holds one site on 10GB, while budget hosts lead with multi-year introductory rates far below that (which then renew higher). 'Unlimited' from Emerald up is bounded by a 2,500,000-inode limit and 75 to 150 processes, round-the-clock phone support starts only at Sapphire (£37), changing your billing cycle takes a support ticket, and VPS is billed monthly only. Cancelling immediately schedules your sites and email for deletion within hours. We have not run Krystal ourselves; this dossier is read from Krystal's own pages and help centre, and we found no independent test we could weigh.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-05 on krystal.io/hosting, /hosting/business, /hosting/wordpress/managed and /cloud-vps) All prices below are in pounds and exclude VAT: the site's Include VAT switch is off by default, so UK buyers add 20%. Shared cPanel hosting comes in six plans: Amethyst £7 a month (1 site, 10GB NVMe storage, 2GB RAM, 1 CPU, daily backups), Ruby £11 (5 sites, 25GB, free domain), Emerald £19 (unlimited sites and NVMe storage, 4-hourly backups, PCI DSS scan compliance), then Sapphire £37, Diamond £67 and Tanzanite £97, each adding CPU and RAM. Annual billing is ten months' price (Amethyst £70 a year, Emerald £190) and two-year billing is eighteen months' price (Amethyst £126, Emerald £342); the page shows no introductory rate. Managed WordPress is £270 for two years on Personal (1 site, 20,000 visits, 5GB), £630 on Business and £900 on Agency, each with a 30-day free trial. A VPS starts at £10 a month (£12 including VAT) for 1 core, 1GB RAM and 25GB, plus £5 per extra core, £3 per extra GB of RAM and £0.20 per extra GB of disk; a cPanel licence is from £18 a month and management from £80 a month. Hosting and VPS carry a 60-day money-back guarantee, less any domain costs.

cost_traps.evidence: Annual billing is ten months' price (Amethyst £70 a year, Emerald £190) and two-year billing is eighteen months' price (Amethyst £126, Emerald £342); the page shows no introductory rate.

compare_with.name: Hostinger
compare_with.why: Hostinger is in our dossiers too and competes on the first invoice: its Premium plan leads with a 48-month prepaid rate that renews several times higher. Krystal lists one price per billing period in pounds, before VAT, with no introductory discount. Compare the two over the full term you will actually keep, at renewal prices, and add VAT to Krystal's figures if you buy in the UK.
